card.name: Words just before concentration or PK terms
card.fires_on: A word right before a drug concentration or pharmacokinetic term, such as 'drug', 'tissue', 'peak' or 'time' ahead of 'concentration', 'half-life' or 'PK'. It marks a spot where a pharmacokinetic noun is expected next.

modes.label: Modifier before concentration
modes.description: A word like drug, peak or expected sits right before 'concentration' or 'levels'.
modes.example: the time of maximum<< drug>> concentration was 6 msec
